Hi Hannah,

Quick update from our side: leadership has just locked the team into a product launch sprint that runs through most of May. We were due to demo with you on Wed (Apr 14) but the execs have asked us to pause all exploration projects until we ship.

Practically that means we need to push the demo out of its current slot and deprioritize the LLM pilot for now. We still want to keep Redwood on the radar — this is a timing issue, not a 'no' — but I can't commit to a new date today.

Can you move the calendar hold to a later date and keep our trial in a soft-waitlist? We'll aim to revisit in early June after the launch settles.

Appreciate your flexibility,
Evan

Let me know which of the above you prefer and if early June sounds right for a revisit. If you want, I can also thread in our solution engineer for a technical sync when you re-open.
